title: Duty to God first!
paragraphs:
Duty to God first!
As a believer of Christ Jesus, we are automatically a disciple of Jesus  and as a disciple we must obey the great commission... Go and make disciples.

Just finished equipping and mentoring these disciples of Christ, the Weegol's Garden  Staffs. Thanks to my cousin Jeremiah Betia Calo for the unending support to let me use his establishment as a venue for my mission. And thanks to bro Mayor Edward U. Chan  for supporting me on my ministry and my mission for the advancement of the kingdom of God.
author: Gospel Warrior (John Domino Sanchez Asis)
